Both blackbox route smoke checks returned HTTP 200 at /login.php. Production UI progress events for all 3 tasks displayed multi-agent review roles 0/4 and recorded that subsequent AI repair and multi-agent report work stopped, later model review was skipped, and a deterministic report was produced. These progress events were transcribed from the live UI accessibility tree; no screenshot, DOM export, or event ID was retained for replay. The downloaded Markdown report and result JSON do not contain these progress events or role-count fields, so those details are documented as live UI observations only, not independently corroborated report data.
